**Summary**
Data analyst with four years of experience turning health system data into decisions. I build Tableau dashboards and automate reporting in Python and SQL. I work closely with finance teams to make the numbers clear and easy to act on.

**Data Analyst | Northwind Health | 2021–2025**

- Built and maintained Tableau dashboards that gave leadership and department heads a single, current view of key operational and financial metrics.
- Automated recurring reports using Python and SQL, replacing manual spreadsheet work and cutting hours of preparation each reporting cycle.
- Partnered with the finance team to define metrics, reconcile data sources, and deliver budget and variance reporting.
- Wrote and optimized SQL queries against production databases to produce accurate, repeatable datasets for analysis.
- Translated stakeholder questions into clear analyses and presented findings to non-technical audiences.
- Documented data definitions and report logic so teammates could trust, reuse, and update the work.
